Do not over-engineer a solution when a simple one is possible. Keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first.
NEVER modify any file under `coder/`; NEVER commit changes to `coder/`.
git submodule update --init coder
Do not add dependency versions in individual crate `Cargo.toml` files.
Never use `.unwrap()` or `.expect()`.
No `.unwrap()` / `.expect()` / `panic!()` / `todo!()` / `dbg!()`.
No `unsafe` code.
No per-crate dependency versions.
Do not modify files under `coder/`.
Do not create separate `tests/` directories.
Use `thiserror` for defining error enums. Propagate with `?`.
Tests live alongside source code in `#[cfg(test)]` modules.
cargo fmt --all
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets
cargo test
cargo build
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo test -p code
